redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each unit addresses a distinct material fact, event, or evaluation target (e.g., headline financials, order book, segments, projects, real estate activity, market outlook, profitability metrics, liquidity, dividends, post-period event). No unit is a subset of or substantially overlapping with another. The net profit margin appears in D1 (headline performance context) and D7 (dedicated profitability metrics), but these represent different evaluation targets (trend vs. detailed ratio analysis) and are complementary, not overlapping.

key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: H1 2026 revenue decreased 10.7% YoY to EUR 150 million (Q2: EUR 92.7 million), net profit decreased to EUR 12.8 million (8.6% margin) in H1 2026 from EUR 21.7 million (12.9%) in H1 2025 (Q2: EUR 8.5 million).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Overview of II Quarter and 6 Months Results; Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income

key_information_units.information: Secured order book reached an all-time high of EUR 836 million as of 30 June 2026 (up 88% YoY from EUR 444 million as of 30 June 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Secured Order Book section

key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Construction services revenue EUR 118.3 million (78.9% of total) with operating profit EUR 3.0 million (2.6% margin); real estate development revenue EUR 31.6 million with operating profit EUR 7.0 million (22.2% margin) in H1 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Business Activities tables, Notes 2 and Reconciliation of Pre-tax Profit

key_information_units.information: Major project developments: Full-scale construction commenced for the EUR 370 million Rūdninkai defence force campus; EUR 80 million in new contracts signed in Q2 2026 including Krulli quarter infrastructure and buildings in Tallinn.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Commentary from Management and Secured Order Book section

key_information_units.information: Real estate development activity: 120 apartments delivered in H1 2026 (vs. 222 in H1 2025); 204 apartments launched; 1,253 apartments under construction/completed with ~40% presold.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate Development section

key_information_units.information: Market outlook: Construction input price pressures persisted; Vilnius apartment market moderated, Riga saw increased activity in lower-priced segments, Tallinn remained stable with high price sensitivity.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Outlook of Construction and Real Estate Market section

key_information_units.information: Profitability metrics: Pre-tax profit margin fell to 7.2% in H1 2026 (from 14.0% in H1 2025); net profit margin 8.6% (vs. 12.9%); EPS EUR 0.73 in H1 2026 (vs. EUR 1.22 in H1 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Ratios table, Management Report Overview, Note 4

key_information_units.information: Liquidity position: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 39.6 million (from EUR 25.9 million); equity EUR 251.1 million (57.4% of assets); net debt EUR 29.6 million as of 30 June 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Cash Position section; Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

key_information_units.information: Dividend payment: EUR 22.1 million (EUR 1.25 per share) approved for 2025 net profit, representing a 55% payout rate.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividends and Dividend Policy section, Note 4

key_information_units.information: Post-reporting-period event: Construction commenced for 50 apartments in the Lahekalda VII development project in Tallinn after 30 June 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate Development section
